title: AMOS-Federation Task
description: Task schema for the runtime domain. Based on the `tasks` Supabase table. A task is a unit of work assigned to an agent.

type.description: Task type (e.g. analysis, generation, review, repair, gap).

description.description: Natural-language description of the work to perform.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the task.

assigned_agent.description: Identifier of the agent assigned to the task.

plan.description: Execution plan produced by the orchestrator for this task.

result.description: Result produced by the agent upon task completion.

domain.description: Domain the task belongs to (e.g. finance, science, health, law).
